gaps.title: Muted ink lightness, darker or lighter than `fg-muted`. Darker: Material 3 on-surface-variant #49454f / #cac4d0 for inactive tabs, drawer labels and supporting text; Geist gray-900 #4d4d4d / #a1a1a1 for inactive tabs, keycaps, modal subtitles and descriptions; GitHub in dark only, `fgColor-muted` #9198a1 (L 0.68) for supporting text and keycap labels (light #59636e matches); Higgsfield, dark only, text-secondary #828282 (L 0.61) and muted text #898a8b (L 0.63), text-tertiary #626262 (L 0.50) on idle underline tabs, #8f8f90 segmented items; Stripe's Dashboard secondary text and resting settings tabs in slate-700 #3C4F69 (oklch ≈ 0.43). Lighter: Duolingo wolf #777777 (L 0.57) in light, and in dark #dce6ec, a step under the #f1f7fb headings, where it doesn't dim body copy (shop descriptions, idle nav and menu rows). Nearer mid-gray in both modes: Airbnb #6c6c6c / #a6a6a6; Notion #7d7a75 (L 0.58) / #ada9a3 (L 0.74) for inactive view tabs and section labels; Claude one muted #898781 (oklch 0.623) in both modes for idle pill tabs, section labels and the sidebar search placeholder. Further from mid-gray in both modes: Wise #454745 (L 0.395) / #e8ebe6 (L 0.936) for idle tabs and secondary text; ChatGPT's signed-in app #5d5d5d / #cdcdcd for secondary text (the Apps SDK library's dark step is #afafaf)
